source_text:
2.2 Περὶ ἀγρῶν ἀφανισμοῦ Ἔσθ'
ὅτε, διοδεύων γῆν πολεμίαν, ταύτης τοὺς ἀγροὺς ἀφανίζειν ἐπιχειρήσεις, ἐλλέβορον
γεωργῶν· τούτῳ γὰρ καὶ Ἀλέξανδρος ὁ Μακεδὼν χρησάμενος τῷ τρόπῳ εἷλεν
Ἀλανούς. Ἀφανίζονται δὲ ἀγροὶἁλῶν τε σπειρομένων ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἀρότροις
ἐγκαλυπτομένων· ἐπὶ πολὺν χρόνον δύναται τοῦ<το αὐ>τοὺς πάνυ κακῶς διαθεῖναι.
pass_a_gloss: 2.2 About of-fields destruction. There-is when, travelling-through land hostile, of-this the fields to-destroy you-will-attempt, hellebore farming; this-for also Alexander the Macedonian having-used the manner took Alans. Are-destroyed but fields of-salts both being-sown in them and with-ploughs being-covered; upon much time is-able this them very badly to-put.
pass_b_english: On the destruction of fields. There are times, travelling through hostile land, when you will attempt to destroy its fields, farming hellebore; for Alexander the Macedonian, using this manner, took the Alans. Fields are also destroyed by salts being sown in them and covered with ploughs; for a long time this can put them in a very bad state.

choices.why: γεωργῶν is cultivating the plant in the enemy fields, the same ruse as Cesti 7.2 vs the Alans.
rejected: farming with hellebore as a tool only

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
